created_at.description: Strict RFC 3339 UTC seconds (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). No fractional seconds; no offsets other than Z.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm identifier. The MVP algorithm is ed25519.

bytes.description: Raw signature bytes encoded with standard base64.

signatures.description: Multi-signature envelope used by attestation-surface emergency statements. Each entry is a single-signer signature; the verifier requires >= attestation_threshold_at(actor, created_at) entries with distinct key_id values. Entries are sorted ascending by key_id in canonical bytes; the JSON form matches that ordering. See ACTORS.md §5.5.3.
